help.title: Flight controls
help.touch: To start: tap LAUNCH MISSION on Relay Seven. LEFT STICK: thrust and RCS strafe. DRAG RIGHT SIDE: steer. RISE / FALL: vertical movement. BOOST / BRAKE: speed. Tap the action prompt to dock, start the spacewalk or repair. Tap pause to hold.
help.gamepad: Gamepad: left stick translate · right stick attitude · A rise · B fall · Y interact · LT brake · LB boost · Start pause
help.note: Bring relative speed below 7 m/s before docking. On EVA, stay inside your tether and reach the beacon before oxygen runs low.
